pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASS: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs

Teach
• Focus skill: identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place?
2. Which word or words do we use to ask questions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
